purpose: Define AI Council's canonical V1 icon meanings before any icon-world geometry is selected. Signature concepts may receive original semantic construction; familiar controls preserve convention and inherit family geometry.

iconClasses.brand-semantic: AI Council-specific concepts where original semantic construction can improve recognition and brand ownership.
iconClasses.convention-dominant: Familiar product controls whose established semantic silhouette should remain immediately recognizable while inheriting AI Council geometry.

displayPolicy.essentialRule: Render when semantic safety, icon-only control recognition, or consequential state depends on the symbol.
displayPolicy.conditionalRule: Render only when the icon contributes information not already obvious from adjacent text/state.
displayPolicy.optionalRule: Default to suppressed in repetitive or dense surfaces; render only when the icon adds a distinct navigational or semantic cue.
displayPolicy.governingPrinciple: Having an icon available does not imply displaying it. Icon absence is part of the system.

icons.label: Project Home
icons.meaning: Return to the selected project's continuation surface.
icons.recognitionRule: Read as project/home destination before branded geometry.
icons.displayRule: Show in navigation when destination recognition benefits; suppress when a labeled Project Home row is already unambiguous.

icons.label: Projects
icons.meaning: Open the project collection or switch project context.
icons.recognitionRule: Multiple related containers/frames; do not resemble Project Memory, files, database cylinders, or flowcharts.
icons.displayRule: Show for project switching/navigation; suppress in repeated content rows.

icons.label: Conversation
icons.meaning: Open or identify a conversation/thread.
icons.recognitionRule: Preserve conversational recognition without robot heads, sparkles, or anthropomorphic AI imagery.
icons.displayRule: Use for thread destinations when it improves scanability; suppress repetitive row decoration.

icons.label: Search
icons.meaning: Search projects, conversations, decisions, memory, files, and actions.
icons.recognitionRule: Preserve the magnifier silhouette; meaning should remain immediate without a label.
icons.displayRule: Required for icon-only search controls; labeled rows may use text alone when space/density requires.

icons.label: Settings
icons.meaning: Open configuration and preferences.
icons.recognitionRule: Familiar settings symbol; do not over-brand into an abstract Council concept.
icons.displayRule: Use in navigation/control surfaces; suppress if a full labeled settings destination already carries sufficient recognition.

icons.label: Activity
icons.meaning: Open chronological project or global activity.
icons.recognitionRule: Read as recent activity/history feed, not provenance lineage.
icons.displayRule: Suppress in dense metadata where Activity is already labeled; use mainly for destination recognition.

icons.label: Attach
icons.meaning: Attach a file, image, repository item, or project artifact.
icons.recognitionRule: Keep conventional attachment recognition; no signature abstraction required.
icons.displayRule: Required for icon-only composer attachment control.

icons.label: Send
icons.meaning: Submit the current request to Council.
icons.recognitionRule: Directional submission must remain obvious at 14–18px and must not be confused with Action/Execute.
icons.displayRule: Required for icon-only send control; text remains primary on consequential Action controls.

icons.label: Back
icons.meaning: Return to the previous navigation context or close a nested mobile sheet.
icons.recognitionRule: Preserve immediate back/navigation recognition without branded semantic embellishment.
icons.displayRule: Required for icon-only back controls and mobile continuity sheets.

icons.label: Inspect
icons.meaning: Open deeper evidence, reasoning summary, traces, or object detail.
icons.recognitionRule: Communicate inspect/reveal rather than search or surveillance.
icons.displayRule: Render when deeper inspectability is not already explicit from the surrounding control label.

icons.label: Edit / Correct
icons.meaning: Modify or correct user-controlled project state.
icons.recognitionRule: Use a familiar edit metaphor; semantic specificity comes from context.
icons.displayRule: Use on actionable objects; suppress in read-only rows.

icons.label: Council
icons.meaning: Multiple relevant perspectives coordinated into one accountable Council judgment.
icons.recognitionRule: Express independent inputs resolving toward judgment without people, robot heads, brains, sparkles, or miniature agent diagrams; remain distinct from Decision.
icons.displayRule: Use when Council composition or synthesis is semantically relevant; suppress on ordinary responses simply branded AI Council.

icons.label: Evidence
icons.meaning: A source or fact registered as support for a claim or decision.
icons.recognitionRule: Express source plus registration/inspection; must not read as Verification or generic document.
icons.displayRule: Render when identifying source/evidence type adds information; suppress repeated evidence-row decoration.

icons.label: Decision
icons.meaning: A durable project judgment selected from alternatives and available for future reference.
icons.recognitionRule: Express alternatives resolving into one chosen direction; not merely a checkmark, Council, or Approval.
icons.displayRule: Use for durable Decision objects and lineage; suppress if the object is already unmistakably labeled as a decision.

icons.label: Project Memory
icons.meaning: Durable project knowledge that remains inspectable, correctable, and provenance-aware.
icons.recognitionRule: Avoid brain, database, archive box, or cloud clichés; remain distinct from Projects at 14–18px.
icons.displayRule: Default to suppressed on repetitive memory rows; use for Memory destination/context identity or exceptional object cues.

icons.label: Provenance / Lineage
icons.meaning: The traceable relationship showing where a claim, decision, action, or memory came from.
icons.recognitionRule: Express a small number of meaningful connected states; do not become a network, activity signal, or node graph.
icons.displayRule: Render only when an actual traceable relationship is available; never decorate unrelated rows.

icons.label: Supersede
icons.meaning: Replace an active truth/decision while retaining the old state in history.
icons.recognitionRule: Communicate old retained plus new active; must not read as Refresh, Retry, Sync, or Delete.
icons.displayRule: Render on actual supersession actions/states; suppress on ordinary memory items.

icons.label: Authority Boundary
icons.meaning: The boundary between Council advice and permission to cause consequential action.
icons.recognitionRule: Express a boundary/gate to action without padlock cliché and remain distinct from Action.
icons.displayRule: Render when approval/authorization boundary must be unmistakable; ordinary advisory surfaces do not display it.

icons.label: Verification
icons.meaning: A claim, action, or result has been checked against relevant conditions/evidence.
icons.recognitionRule: Express checked/registered result without collapsing into Evidence, Approve, or generic success.
icons.displayRule: Render when verification state adds information beyond adjacent status text; failures may become semantically essential through state context.

icons.label: History
icons.meaning: A durable earlier state or sequence that remains accessible after resolution.
icons.recognitionRule: Read as temporal history, distinct from source provenance and current activity.
icons.displayRule: Suppress repeated history decoration; use for explicit history destination/lineage controls.

icons.label: Action
icons.meaning: A proposed or executed change to repository/system/external state.
icons.recognitionRule: Communicate consequential directed change, distinct from Send, Authority, and ordinary navigation arrows.
icons.displayRule: Render when mutation/execution identity adds information; suppress if a labeled action control is already explicit.

icons.label: Approve
icons.meaning: Grant permission for the currently proposed action.
icons.recognitionRule: Use familiar confirmation logic but remain distinct from Verification; explicit text remains primary on consequential controls.
icons.displayRule: Render on icon-plus-label approval controls; never use as a generic verified-state badge.

icons.label: Reject
icons.meaning: Decline the current proposal or state transition.
icons.recognitionRule: Read as reject/decline, not merely close/dismiss; consequential controls retain labels.
icons.displayRule: Render on explicit rejection controls; labels remain required for consequential actions.

icons.label: Retry
icons.meaning: Attempt the same permitted operation again after a failure or transient issue.
icons.recognitionRule: Preserve familiar retry semantics and remain clearly distinct from Supersede.
icons.displayRule: Render only when retry is available as an action.

icons.label: Blocked
icons.meaning: A requirement prevents the operation or decision from proceeding.
icons.recognitionRule: Communicate stopped/not permitted without becoming the Authority glyph itself.
icons.displayRule: Render when a blocker must interrupt normal flow or when icon-only status recognition is needed.

icons.label: Authorized
icons.meaning: Required permission has been granted for a defined scope.
icons.recognitionRule: Read as authorization state rather than generic success; text/state remains primary.
icons.displayRule: Render when granted authority is a meaningful state change; suppress during routine post-authorization execution.

roles.evidence: evidence violet when the use state represents inspectable evidence
roles.lineage: lineage green only for real provenance/chronology relationships
roles.consequence: vermilion only for approval required, blocked/destructive/high-risk/failure/security boundaries
